manual.description: Today: I research, implement and fix everything myself. I check my own work as I go, so nothing is routed for a separate check. My know-how stays where it is: nobody writes a playbook, and nothing decays.

no-learning.description: Agents, but nobody writes the playbook: failures are fixed and forgotten.

surge.description: Twice the asks from week one (a reorganisation sends everything my way).

surge-protected.description: The surge, with lesson capture protected: lessons are written down however long the backlog.

blind-trust.description: Agents, starting with high trust (80): I check little from day one.
